The simulation uses a 3D environment to create depth and realism, with the dominoes falling in sequence and initiating the lava-like flows. The color palette shifts between warm oranges and reds, mimicking the appearance of cooling lava while maintaining an unstable, ever-shifting pattern of expansion. The blooms propagate slowly and continuously, filling the space with intricate, flowing forms that evolve over time, creating a mesmerizing display of fluid dynamics in a controlled environment.
